title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يترأس المجلس الإداري للمركز
title_en: The Sheikh Chairs the Centre's Administrative Board
body_ar:
ترأس فضيلة الشيخ : محمد الحسن ولد الددو –حفظه الله- ظهر اليوم السبت 6 رمضان 1437هـ الموافق: 11 يونيو 2016م اجتماع مجلس إدارة مركز تكوين العلماء في دورته العادية الثالثة للعام الدراسي 2015- 2016، بحضور المدير العام للمركز الدكتور محمد المختار ولد محمد المامي وأعضاء المجلس.

وسيناقش المجلس ضمن جدول أعماله أبرز بنود الخطة التسييرية في الفترة المنصرمة، ويتخذ القرارات اللازمة بشأن مختلف النقاط التي شملها جدول أعماله، ويعتمد الترتيبات التي من شأنها أن تعطي انسيابية للعملية الإدارية والتنفيذية، وتحسن الأداء في مختلف المجالات التي يوليها المركز اهتمامه.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew (may God preserve him) chaired, at midday this Saturday, 6 Ramadan 1437 AH, corresponding to 11 June 2016, the meeting of the board of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars in its third ordinary session of the 2015–2016 academic year, in the presence of the Centre's director general, Dr Muhammad al-Mukhtar Ould Muhammad al-Mami, and the members of the board.

On its agenda the board will discuss the principal items of the management plan for the period just past; take the decisions required on the various points its agenda covers; and adopt the arrangements apt to give fluency to the administrative and executive process and to improve performance in the various fields to which the Centre gives its attention.

flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT, recorded not fixed: the body dates the meeting to Saturday 11 June 2016, which is internally consistent (11 June 2016 was a Saturday). The CMS stamps the record Sunday 12 June 2016. This is a further instance of the corpus-wide problem that CMS dates are upload timestamps rather than event or composition dates; here the two differ by a day and the display must not present the CMS date as the date of the meeting.

translator_notes: Distinguish from record 917 and record 899, which carry closely related titles about the same board; these are different ordinary sessions, not duplicates.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, not the date of composition.
